name: Grid Battery Storage State of Charge
description: State of charge of a grid-connected BESS after a frequency regulation event. Checks whether minimum SoC for next event is preserved.

elements.name: SoC After Frequency Regulation
elements.description: Battery SoC remaining after delivering primary frequency response. Uncertain due to event magnitude and duration.

uncertainty.source: Frequency event statistics from 5-year ENTSO-E data

elements.name: Minimum SoC for Service Availability
elements.description: Minimum SoC required to remain available for next regulation event

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(SoC_post) = SoC_post if SoC_post >= SoC_min, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The minimum service availability SoC guards the post-event SoC uncertainty set; values below 20% make the BESS unavailable for the next regulation event.
